in_sanskrit.name: लक्ष्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The object or goal one has in view; the point or mark to which one makes an effort to reach; the aim, the purpose, the end, the design.

in_hindi.name: लक्षय
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mooltah Uddeeshya: Root cause or the fundamental reason, the goal or the objective.

in_marathi.name: Lakshay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goal, Aim, Destination
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshay is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'lakshya' meaning goal, aim, or destination. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, is often depicted holding a lotus flower with a dot, or bindu, at its base. This bindu symbolizes the ultimate goal or purpose in life, which is to attain spiritual enlightenment. The name Lakshay signifies the journey towards this ultimate goal.
